title: Hearty Sour Norwegian Rhubarb Bake
description: This recipe combines the tartness of rhubarb with the sweetness of dark rum and a hint of Norway's culinary heritage. Perfect for a lazy Sunday morning or afternoon.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the rhubarb, brown sugar, and grated ginger. Let it sit for about 15 minutes, until the rhubarb starts to release its juices.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the flour, baking powder, baking soda, and salt.
Add the melted butter to the dry ingredients and mix until crumbly.
Add the dark rum to the rhubarb mixture and stir to combine.
Add the dry ingredients to the rhubarb mixture and stir until just combined.
Pour the batter into a 9x13 inch baking dish and smooth the top.
Bake in a preheated oven at 375°F (190°C) for 35-40 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean.
Let the bake cool for 10-15 minutes before serving.
Serve warm with a dollop of coconut whipped cream or a scoop of vanilla ice cream, if desired.
